args.body:
• Newsletter (Saltmarsh Foods, "Cold-chain logistics in 2026"): Announces this week's feature on cold-chain logistics in 2026, linking to the main article at blog.saltmarsh.example and offering free, no-password registration (via email) for the companion piece on insights.saltmarsh.example.
• Main article: Temperature excursions fell 30% where carriers shared live sensor data; most of the savings came from fewer rejected loads rather than reduced spoilage.
• Companion piece: Cold-chain pilots cut claims by a quarter.
args.title: Saltmarsh Foods cold-chain newsletter summary
